purpose: Machine-readable cross-chat continuity index. Prevent rediscovery loops by forcing source recovery before new gates.

current_global_frontier.rule: Do not let historical C022/C023/C023R diagnostics or scoped bicameral carrier passes silently replace global APMA frontier authority.

JUXTAPOSE.role: Adaptive search prioritization backed by exact replay; prediction/search priority is not proof authority.

AKINATOR.role: Adaptive exact-question skeleton. Question count and answer cost are separate resources; small question count alone is not a polynomial SAT algorithm.
AKINATOR.known_blocker: deterministic polynomial-time proof-carrying exact answerer for sufficiently useful progress questions

CAPTAIN_OBVIOUS.role: Status-first compression: recover full relevant history, identify what is already solved, choose one nearest missing obligation, avoid unnecessary redesign.

JANUS_SOVEREIGN.role: Governance/commit authority; must not be conflated with scientific theorem authority.
JANUS_SOVEREIGN.warning: Library contains SovereignGate implementations in other JANUS/RBLGANUL lineages. Do not silently treat those as the canonical TRUMP Janus-Sovereign contract without provenance binding.

JANUS_DEMIURGE.role: Construct exact candidates/transitions/certificates; construction is distinct from governance and scientific promotion.

HRAIN_INAIHR_BICAMERAL_EXPLANATION.role: Hrain supplies deterministic structural observation; iNaiHR supplies candidate-only explanation proposals with provenance; Captain/PCNER red-teams assumptions/resources; TRUMP alone exact-replays and admits/rejects; Sovereign may commit only after frozen PASS.
HRAIN_INAIHR_BICAMERAL_EXPLANATION.known_closed_scope: single-variable incidence articulation conditioning over explicit Boolean relation tables when both exact branches replay into sealed compositional basis portfolios
HRAIN_INAIHR_BICAMERAL_EXPLANATION.known_blocker: historical successor blocker was a connected mixed raw core without a valid single-variable articulation explanation; later successor states v2.6-v2.9 have advanced beyond this blocker

BICAMERAL_CANONICAL_MINCUT_LOGWIDTH.role: Discover a globally minimum variable-only cut by polynomial node-splitting/max-flow rather than subset enumeration; authorize raw conditioning only when 2^k<=L before enumeration.
BICAMERAL_CANONICAL_MINCUT_LOGWIDTH.closed_scope: Polynomial canonical cut discovery and exact raw conditioning when 2^k<=L.
BICAMERAL_CANONICAL_MINCUT_LOGWIDTH.firewall: When 2^k>L the gate returns OPEN before raw branch enumeration.

EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT.role: Representation/query-contract barrier plus strict affine-syndrome exact quotient door. Equality of syndrome is admissible only when every frozen downstream observable exactly factors through the syndrome basis.
EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT.known_positive_scope: Strict affine downstream contract with polynomial syndrome image and exact factor maps/reconstruction.
EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT.known_barrier: Unrestricted coordinate-observation contracts can force 2^k distinguishable classes.
EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT.forbidden_overclaim: Do not assume arbitrary cut components are affine and do not treat the U1 representation barrier as a general SAT lower bound.

BICAMERAL_OVERWIDTH_CUT_SUPPORT_INTERSEC.role: For an overwidth canonical cut whose cut-separated constraint-bearing components are singleton explicit relations, project each relation's existing rows to the cut and intersect the supports; reconstruct one original row per component for an exact witness.
BICAMERAL_OVERWIDTH_CUT_SUPPORT_INTERSEC.closed_scope: Overwidth canonical mincut plus exactly one explicit relation per cut-separated component; exact SAT/witness by support intersection with carrier size bounded by explicit input rows and zero raw 2^k enumeration.
BICAMERAL_OVERWIDTH_CUT_SUPPORT_INTERSEC.current_successor_blocker: Multi-relation components with raw full-cut anchors and verified join trees are now closed by v2.9; remaining components lack a full-cut anchor or verified join-tree carrier.

BICAMERAL_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE_BOUNDARY_C.role: For an overwidth canonical cut with multi-relation cut components, use only raw full-cut anchor-row projections as candidate cut states, verify a deterministic relation tree satisfies running intersection, exact-test each anchor state by tree semijoin/DP, intersect component supports and replay one original-row witness per relation.
BICAMERAL_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE_BOUNDARY_C.closed_scope: Overwidth cut components with an explicit raw full-cut anchor and a verified running-intersection relation tree. Candidate cut states are bounded by anchor input rows; exact component semantics use tree semijoin/DP with no raw cut cube or full join materialization.
BICAMERAL_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE_BOUNDARY_C.negative_authority: Predecessor-admitted hostile three-relation private-variable cycle remains OPEN_NO_VERIFIED_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE in both candidate and independent checker.
BICAMERAL_COMPONENT_JOIN_TREE_BOUNDARY_C.current_successor_blocker: Components without any raw full-cut anchor, or components whose relation scopes fail running intersection, require a different exact polynomial boundary quotient/message.

FULL_HISTORY_SPIRAL.role: Diagnostic/history reconstruction only; provenance-indexed synthesis before selecting a new gate.

before_new_mechanism: classify as NEW_MECHANISM, REDISCOVERY, SUCCESSOR_REPAIR, DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY, or SUPERSEDED_ROUTE
never: reconstruct a historical module from memory when a source can be recovered
promote a finite diagnostic to theorem evidence
let a search heuristic vote for scientific PASS
repeat fixed-k or raw overwidth enumeration after v2.9
rediscover the full-cut-anchor verified-join-tree carrier as if new
assume affine quotient applicability without exact factor-through adequacy
materialize an unbounded join/project and call it polynomial

update_policy: Append/index every newly recovered durable mechanism or alias when material to future work. Do not rely on conversational memory as the only copy.
